notes: Do NOT copy into crawler/feeds/live or add to ingest_live_feeds_postgres.py whitelist until Fehmi confirms merchants + legal term matrix.
Excel company_codes / fin_codes were empty; merchant_codes left empty on purpose (no invented merchant mapping).
category_codes use DB taxonomy codes (MOBILE_PHONE/TABLET/LAPTOP), NOT Fehmi Excel numeric ids (1/3/4).
Albaraka phone max-term depends on purchase amount (>20k → 3 ay, ≤20k → 6 ay). Encoded as separate draft rows because eligibility has no category×amount term rule yet.
monthly_rate_pct is required for rate snapshots (rate_apr alone is skipped by generic.campaign_feed.v1).
valid_until 2099-09-09 is CMS placeholder from source; treat as open-ended until bank confirms.
